title: Guardrail Erosion in Domain Fine-Tuned Large Language Models: A Paired Audit of Knowledge-Centric Abstention in Biomedical LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2611.08780v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The number of domain fine-tuned models, particularly in the biomedical domain, is rapidly expanding. Fine-tuning promises high-performing models at a fraction of the cost of training a base model, but it can also produce unintended behavioral changes. Multiple studies have shown that safety guardrails can erode with fine-tuning, yet large-scale studies across model architectures, data mixtures, and fine-tuning methodologies remain limited. Where prior work in this space has studied value-centric refusal, this work focuses on knowledge-centric abstention. We audit 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned large language models against 11 paired base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench to evaluate the impact of fine-tuning on knowledge-centric abstention. translated_title: 领域微调大语言模型中的护栏侵蚀：对生物医学大语言模型中知识型拒答能力的配对审计
translated_abstract: 领域微调模型的数量，尤其是在生物医学领域，正在迅速增长。微调承诺以远低于训练基础模型的成本获得高性能模型，但它也可能带来意料之外的行为改变。多项研究表明，安全护栏会随着微调而受到侵蚀，然而涵盖不同模型架构、数据配比和微调方法的大规模研究仍然有限。以往工作主要研究以价值观为中心的拒绝行为，而本研究聚焦于以知识为中心的拒答（abstention）。我们在 MedAbstain 和 ClinDet-Bench 两个基准上，将 25 个生物医学领域微调的大语言模型与其对应的 11 个基础模型检查点进行配对审计，以评估微调对知识型拒答能力的影响。我们发现，这些基准所度量的明确定义的适当拒答能力在基础模型中本就很低（MedAbstain 上中位数为 8.3%），微调后进一步下降（中位数降至 4.2%，并在……持续减少）
tldr: 本研究通过对 25 个生物医学领域微调大语言模型与其基础模型的配对大规模审计，首次揭示微调会进一步侵蚀本已薄弱的知识型拒答能力，证明领域微调会导致模型安全护栏的系统性退化。
en_tdlr: Through a large-scale paired audit of 25 biomedical domain fine-tuned LLMs against 11 base checkpoints on MedAbstain and ClinDet-Bench, this work reveals that knowledge-centric abstention—already low in base models—erodes further after fine-tuning, demonstrating systematic guardrail erosion in domain fine-tuned models.
